summary: Pilot-only validation: frozen stab05 screen (11 feats) + nested 3x5 GBM tuning -> cv_auc to out/metrics.json
reasoning: Following the route's method literally - a screen fitted on pilot data alone, then GBM tuned on pilot data alone - I freeze the bootstrap-majority stab screen (thr=0.5, 11 features, matching the sealed 10-feature stability precedents) on the whole pilot, and estimate a HistGradientBoostingClassifier (grid: lr {0.05,0.1} x leaves {15,31}, 200 iters, 64 bins, min leaf 5) by nested 3x5-fold CV with the grid retuned inside every outer fold, on the locked features only. The pilot sweep just showed fixed-screen GBM at 0.745-0.757 on 20 features and the sealed stab+GBM precedent measured 0.7645 with 10 features, so the honest nested estimate should be >= 0.70 with n_features = 11 <= 50. A leaky reference (repeated CV of the tuned config) is reported alongside to bound the screen-selection optimism. Heldout is never read; out/metrics.json gets flat pilot-only numbers only.
